profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer with experience building business applications.  Dedicated to growth and learning and a collaborative attitude as a core part of software development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing a federated GraphQL platform, schema, and contribution model.  Developing tooling around contributing to the federation, including developer tools, coding examples, deploy processes, and documentation.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · React.js · GraphQL · Apollo GraphQL

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Developing internal web applications for Facebook using React, GraphQL, and Hack.  Providing data insights using Presto(SQL) and Tableau.

positions.title: Associate Business Analytics Consultant
positions.description:
As a business analytics consultant I bring the experience of the end-to-end solutions that Saama has to offer to help businesses do business better.

Technologies:
ETL:
-SSIS
-Informatica

Querying/Aggregation:
-Microsoft SQL
-MySQL
-Hadoop Hive

Visualization:
-Tableau
-QlikView
-Qlik Sense

positions.title: Service and Security Professional
positions.description: Primary contact for law enforcement and legal issues regarding customer privacy and security for the textPlus texting app.  Familiarity with subpoena and search warrant compliance.  General customer service for iOS and Android devices, maintenance of customer service web portal and FAQ’s.  Gathering and maintaining metrics on customer experience and responding to customer reviews in Google Play Store.

volunteerExperiences.description: Student mentor to science students at Concord High School.  Worked with junior and senior high school science students to encourage learning and engaging with science and technology in hands on labs.  Also acted as a mentor for the week long solar science academy event at CSUEB Concord focusing on educating students on solar energy.
